TERMS & CONDITIONS 
JSG SMILE – Jharsuguda Supplier & MSME Integrated Local Exchange 
Website: www.jsgsmile.in 
Effective Date: [30/07/2026] 
 
1. INTRODUCTION 
JSG SMILE (www.jsgsmile.in) (“Portal”) is a procurement facilitation platform established 
under the guidance of the District Industries Centre (DIC), Jharsuguda, Government of 
Odisha, to promote business opportunities between Large Buyers and Micro, Small and 
Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) located within Jharsuguda District. 
The Portal aims to encourage local sourcing, strengthen MSME participation in 
procurement, support economic development, and facilitate business interactions 
between buyers and suppliers. 
By accessing, registering, or using the Portal, you agree to comply with and be bound by 
these Terms & Conditions. 
 
2. DEFINITIONS 
For the purposes of these Terms: 
Buyer means any government department, public sector undertaking, private company, 
institution, organization, cooperative, NGO, or business entity registered on the Portal for 
procurement purposes. 
Supplier/MSME means any eligible MSME, manufacturer, trader, service provider, startup, 
cooperative, self-help group, or business entity registered on the Portal and operating 
within Jharsuguda District. 
Portal means JSG SMILE accessible through www.jsgsmile.in. 
Order means any purchase order, work order, service request, quotation acceptance, or 
commercial commitment between Buyer and Supplier. 
User means any registered or unregistered visitor accessing the Portal. 

 
3. NATURE OF THE PORTAL 
3.1 JSG SMILE is solely a digital facilitation platform. 
3.2 The Portal facilitates: 
• Supplier discovery 
• Buyer discovery 
• Product and service listing 
• Request for Quotations (RFQs) 
• Procurement opportunities 
• Communication between Buyers and Suppliers 
• Payment tracking and transaction visibility 
3.3 The Portal does not: 
• Act as Buyer or Seller 
• Enter into contracts on behalf of users 
• Guarantee business opportunities 
• Guarantee payments 
• Guarantee product quality 
• Guarantee service quality 
• Guarantee order fulfillment 
 
4. ELIGIBILITY FOR REGISTRATION 
4.1 Buyers 
The following entities may register: 
• Government Departments 
• Public Sector Undertakings 
• Private Companies 
• Industries 
• Educational Institutions 
• Hospitals 
• NGOs 
• Cooperatives 

• Registered Business Organizations 
4.2 Suppliers 
Suppliers must possess: 
• Valid Udyam Registration (where applicable) 
• Business presence within Jharsuguda District 
• PAN 
• GST Registration (if applicable) 
• Active Bank Account 
• Authorized Signatory Details 
The Portal reserves the right to approve, reject, suspend, or terminate registrations. 
 
5. USER REGISTRATION AND ACCOUNT SECURITY 
5.1 Users shall provide accurate, complete, and updated information. 
5.2 Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of login credentials. 
5.3 Users shall immediately notify the Portal of any unauthorized account access. 
5.4 The Portal reserves the right to verify user information at any stage. 
 
6. BUYER RESPONSIBILITIES 
Buyers agree to: 
• Provide genuine procurement requirements. 
• Issue accurate specifications. 
• Communicate honestly with Suppliers. 
• Make payments as agreed. 
• Comply with applicable laws and regulations. 
• Accept or reject deliveries within reasonable timelines. 
Buyers shall not misuse supplier information or engage in unfair trade practices. 
 

7. SUPPLIER RESPONSIBILITIES 
Suppliers agree to: 
• Provide accurate company information. 
• Maintain valid registrations and licenses. 
• Deliver products/services as committed. 
• Comply with quality standards. 
• Honor warranties and service commitments. 
• Maintain legal and statutory compliance. 
Suppliers are solely responsible for products and services supplied through transactions 
initiated via the Portal. 
 
8. PRODUCT AND SERVICE LISTINGS 
8.1 Suppliers may list products and services on the Portal. 
8.2 Listings must be accurate and lawful. 
8.3 The Portal may remove listings that are: 
• False 
• Misleading 
• Offensive 
• Illegal 
• Infringing third-party rights 
8.4 The Portal does not certify or endorse listed products or services. 
 
9. REQUEST FOR QUOTATION (RFQ) 
9.1 Buyers may publish procurement requirements. 
9.2 Suppliers may submit quotations. 
9.3 Buyers shall independently evaluate quotations. 
9.4 The Portal shall not influence procurement decisions. 
 

10. ORDER PLACEMENT AND ACCEPTANCE 
10.1 Orders are placed directly between Buyers and Suppliers. 
10.2 The Portal is not a party to any Order. 
10.3 Commercial terms including: 
• Pricing 
• Quantity 
• Delivery timelines 
• Warranty conditions 
• Payment terms 
shall be mutually agreed between Buyer and Supplier. 
 
11. PAYMENT GATEWAY AND SETTLEMENT 
11.1 The Portal may provide integrated payment gateway facilities through authorized 
third-party payment partners. 
11.2 Payments may be processed through a secure transaction management framework. 
11.3 The Portal may provide transaction tracking and payment visibility. 
11.4 Settlement to Suppliers may generally occur on a T+1 basis after completion and 
acceptance of the transaction, subject to: 
• Banking timelines 
• Regulatory requirements 
• Payment gateway policies 
• Verification processes 
11.5 The Portal itself does not hold customer funds and does not operate as a bank or 
financial institution. 
 
12. REFUNDS AND CHARGEBACKS 
12.1 Refunds may be processed in accordance with: 
• Buyer-Supplier agreements 

• Payment partner policies 
• Applicable laws 
12.2 Chargebacks and payment disputes shall be governed by banking and payment 
gateway regulations. 
12.3 The Portal reserves the right to temporarily suspend settlement pending investigation 
of disputed transactions. 
 
13. TAX COMPLIANCE 
All Users shall be solely responsible for: 
• GST compliance 
• Income Tax obligations 
• TDS compliance 
• Regulatory filings 
• Statutory deductions 
The Portal assumes no responsibility for tax compliance of Users. 
 
14. QUALITY AND WARRANTY DISCLAIMER 
The Portal does not guarantee: 
• Product quality 
• Service quality 
• Product suitability 
• Technical specifications 
• Compliance certifications 
All such responsibilities rest solely with the Supplier. 
 
15. DELIVERY DISCLAIMER 
The Portal is not responsible for: 
• Delivery delays 

• Damaged goods 
• Logistics failures 
• Short deliveries 
• Incorrect shipments 
Delivery obligations remain solely between Buyer and Supplier. 
 
16. DISPUTE RESOLUTION 
Any dispute regarding: 
• Pricing 
• Quantity 
• Quality 
• Delivery 
• Warranty 
• Payment 
• Service performance 
shall be resolved directly between Buyer and Supplier. 
The Portal shall not act as an arbitrator, mediator, or adjudicating authority. 
 
17. FRAUD PREVENTION 
The Portal reserves the right to: 
• Verify user information 
• Request additional documents 
• Suspend suspicious transactions 
• Restrict access 
• Report unlawful activities to competent authorities 
 
18. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY 
All content, software, designs, logos, trademarks, and branding associated with JSG SMILE 
are protected under applicable intellectual property laws. 

Users shall not copy, modify, distribute, or misuse Portal content without authorization. 
 
19. PRIVACY AND DATA USAGE 
Users consent to the collection, storage, processing, and use of data for:

• Transaction facilitation 
• Communication 
• Analytics 
• Government reporting 
• Platform improvement 
Data handling shall be governed by the Portal Privacy Policy. 
 
20. SUSPENSION AND TERMINATION 
The Portal may suspend or terminate user accounts for: 
• False information 
• Fraudulent activity 
• Violation of these Terms 
• Misuse of the Portal 
• Legal non-compliance 
Such actions may be taken without prior notice where deemed necessary. 
 
21. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Industries Centre (DIC), Government of Odisha, Technology Partner, Portal Operator, and 
their officers shall not be liable for:

• Indirect or consequential damages 
The maximum liability of the Portal and associated entities shall be NIL. 
 
22. INDEMNITY 
Users agree to indemnify and hold harmless:

• District Industries Centre (DIC) 
• Government of Odisha 
• Technology Partner 
• Portal Operator 
against any claims, losses, damages, liabilities, penalties, costs, or legal expenses arising 
from their use of the Portal. 
 
23. FORCE MAJEURE 
Neither the Portal nor its stakeholders shall be liable for delays or failures resulting from: 
• Natural disasters 
• Floods 
• Earthquakes 
• Pandemics 
• Government restrictions 
• Power failures 
• Internet disruptions 
• Cybersecurity incidents 
• Other events beyond reasonable control 
 

24. GOVERNING LAW 
These Terms & Conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws 
of India. 
 
25. JURISDICTION

26. MODIFICATIONS

Updated Terms shall become effective upon publication on the Portal. 
 
27. DISCLAIMER

28. ACCEPTANCE OF TERMS

MSME REGISTRATION & SUPPLIER PARTICIPATION 
AGREEMENT 
This MSME Registration & Supplier Participation Agreement (“Agreement”) governs the 
registration, participation, product/service listing, quotation submission, order execution, 
and business transactions conducted by Suppliers through JSG SMILE (www.jsgsmile.in). 
JSG SMILE is a procurement facilitation platform established under the guidance of the 
District Industries Centre (DIC), Jharsuguda, Government of Odisha, to promote 
procurement opportunities for MSMEs operating within Jharsuguda District. 
By registering on the Portal, the Supplier agrees to be legally bound by this Agreement, the 
Portal Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, Payment Policies, and all other applicable Portal 
policies. 
 
1. OBJECTIVE 
The objective of this Agreement is to facilitate business opportunities for MSMEs by 
enabling them to: 
• Showcase products and services. 
• Receive procurement enquiries. 
• Participate in RFQs. 
• Submit quotations. 
• Receive purchase orders. 
• Track transactions and payments. 
• Connect with large buyers and institutions. 
 

2. ELIGIBILITY 
To register as a Supplier on JSG SMILE, the Applicant must: 
Mandatory Requirements 
• Be located within Jharsuguda District. 
• Be legally operating in India. 
• Possess a valid PAN. 
• Maintain an active bank account. 
• Possess applicable licenses and registrations. 
Preferred Registrations 
• Udyam Registration 
• GST Registration 
• Startup Recognition 
• Industry Certifications 
• Quality Certifications 
The Portal reserves the right to define eligibility criteria from time to time. 
 
3. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED 
The Supplier may be required to submit: 
Organization Documents 
• Udyam Registration Certificate 
• PAN Card 
• GST Registration Certificate 
• Certificate of Incorporation/Registration 
• Trade License (where applicable) 
• Factory License (where applicable) 
Banking Documents 
• Cancelled Cheque 
• Bank Verification Documents 
• Account Holder Details 
Authorized Representative 
• Aadhaar/Identity Proof 

• Mobile Number 
• Email Address 
• Authorization Letter (if applicable) 
The Portal may request additional documents for verification purposes. 
 
4. REGISTRATION AND VERIFICATION 
4.1 Registration shall be subject to verification. 
4.2 The Portal may: 
• Verify submitted documents. 
• Conduct physical verification where required. 
• Request clarification or additional information. 
• Approve, reject, suspend, or revoke registration. 
4.3 Registration approval does not constitute endorsement or certification by the Portal. 
 
5. SUPPLIER PROFILE 
The Supplier may maintain a profile containing: 
• Organization Details 
• Product Categories 
• Service Offerings 
• Capacity Information 
• Certifications 
• Contact Details 
• Portfolio Information 
The Supplier shall ensure that all information remains accurate and updated. 
 
6. PRODUCT AND SERVICE LISTINGS 
The Supplier may list products and services on the Portal. 
The Supplier shall ensure that all listings: 

• Are accurate. 
• Are lawful. 
• Are not misleading. 
• Do not infringe third-party rights. 
The Portal reserves the right to remove or suspend any listing without prior notice. 
 
7. RFQ PARTICIPATION 
The Supplier may: 
• View procurement requirements. 
• Participate in RFQs. 
• Submit quotations. 
• Respond to buyer enquiries. 
Submission of quotations does not guarantee award of business. 
The Buyer shall independently evaluate quotations. 
 
8. ORDER ACCEPTANCE 
The Supplier shall: 
• Carefully review purchase orders. 
• Accept only executable orders. 
• Honor accepted commitments. 
Once accepted, the Supplier shall make reasonable efforts to fulfill obligations in 
accordance with agreed terms. 
 
9. DELIVERY OBLIGATIONS 
The Supplier shall: 
• Deliver products/services as agreed. 
• Meet quality specifications. 
• Follow applicable safety and regulatory requirements. 

• Maintain proper documentation. 
The Supplier remains solely responsible for delivery performance. 
 
10. PRODUCT QUALITY RESPONSIBILITY 
The Supplier shall be solely responsible for: 
• Product quality. 
• Service quality. 
• Product specifications. 
• Compliance certifications. 
• Product safety. 
• Packaging standards. 
• Warranty obligations. 
• After-sales service. 
The Portal shall not verify or guarantee product quality. 
 
11. PAYMENT FACILITATION 
Where enabled, JSG SMILE may provide integrated payment gateway facilities. 
Payment Process 
1. Buyer places order. 
2. Buyer completes payment through approved payment mechanism. 
3. Transaction is recorded on the Portal. 
4. Delivery/service completion is confirmed. 
5. Settlement is processed. 
T+1 Settlement 
Settlement may generally be processed on a T+1 basis following transaction completion 
and confirmation, subject to: 
• Banking timelines 
• Payment gateway processing 
• Regulatory requirements 
• Compliance verification 

The Portal does not guarantee settlement timelines. 
 
12. BANK ACCOUNT VALIDATION 
The Supplier shall ensure: 
• Correct bank account details. 
• Accurate beneficiary information. 
• Updated banking records. 
The Portal shall not be responsible for losses caused by incorrect banking information 
submitted by the Supplier. 
 
13. TAXATION 
The Supplier shall be solely responsible for: 
• GST compliance 
• Tax invoices 
• Income tax obligations 
• TDS reconciliation 
• Regulatory filings 
• Statutory compliance 
The Portal shall not provide tax advice. 
 
14. REFUNDS, RETURNS AND DISPUTES 
Any refund, return, replacement, warranty claim, or commercial dispute shall be resolved 
directly between Buyer and Supplier. 
The Portal may provide communication support but shall not adjudicate disputes. 
 
15. CONFIDENTIALITY 
The Supplier shall keep confidential: 

• Buyer information 
• Procurement requirements 
• Commercial discussions 
• Pricing details 
• Business information 
Unauthorized disclosure is prohibited. 
 
16. FRAUD PREVENTION 
The Supplier shall not: 
• Submit false documents. 
• Misrepresent products. 
• Misrepresent certifications. 
• Engage in fraudulent transactions. 
• Manipulate quotations. 
• Create duplicate accounts. 
The Portal reserves the right to report suspected fraud to competent authorities. 
 
17. RATINGS AND FEEDBACK 
The Portal may provide a rating and feedback mechanism. 
The Supplier acknowledges that: 
• Buyers may submit reviews. 
• Performance indicators may be displayed. 
• Ratings may influence visibility. 
The Portal shall not guarantee any specific ranking or visibility. 
 
18. SUSPENSION AND BLACKLISTING 
The Portal may suspend, restrict, or blacklist Suppliers for: 
• Fraudulent activities. 

• False documentation. 
• Misleading product information. 
• Repeated order defaults. 
• Legal violations. 
• Misuse of the Portal. 
Such action may be taken without prior notice where necessary. 
 
19. DISCLAIMER 
The Supplier acknowledges that: 
• JSG SMILE is only a facilitation platform. 
• The Portal does not guarantee orders. 
• The Portal does not guarantee buyer payments. 
• The Portal does not guarantee business opportunities. 
• The Portal does not guarantee revenue generation. 
Participation on the Portal is entirely voluntary. 
 
20. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY 
District Administration Jharsuguda, District Industries Centre (DIC), Government of 
Odisha, Technology Partner, Portal Operator, and their officers shall not be liable for: 
• Loss of business. 
• Loss of profits. 
• Buyer defaults. 
• Payment delays. 
• Commercial disputes. 
• Product returns. 
• Warranty claims. 
• Consequential damages. 
Maximum liability shall be NIL to the fullest extent permitted under applicable law. 
 

21. INDEMNITY 
The Supplier agrees to indemnify and hold harmless: 
• District Administration Jharsuguda 
• District Industries Centre (DIC) 
• Government of Odisha 
• Technology Partner 
• Portal Operator 
against any claims, liabilities, damages, penalties, losses, legal expenses, or proceedings 
arising from: 
• Supplier products. 
• Supplier services. 
• Regulatory violations. 
• Intellectual property infringement. 
• Product defects. 
• Contractual disputes. 
 
22. GOVERNING LAW 
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. 
 
23. JURISDICTION 
Any legal proceedings arising under this Agreement shall be subject to the exclusive 
jurisdiction of competent courts located in Odisha. 
 
24. MODIFICATION OF AGREEMENT 
The Portal reserves the right to amend this Agreement from time to time. 
Continued use of the Portal shall constitute acceptance of revised terms. 
 

25. DECLARATION AND ACCEPTANCE 
By selecting “I Agree”, registering on JSG SMILE, uploading documents, listing 
products/services, submitting quotations, accepting orders, receiving payments, or 
otherwise using the Portal, the Supplier declares that: 
1. All information submitted is true and accurate. 
2. The organization is legally authorized to conduct business. 
3. The applicant is authorized to represent the organization. 
4. The Supplier has read and understood this Agreement. 
5. The Supplier agrees to comply with all Portal policies and applicable laws.

JSG SMILE – Jharsuguda Supplier & MSME Integrated Local Exchange 
Website: www.jsgsmile.in 
Effective Date: [DD/MM/YYYY] 
 
1. PURPOSE 
This Vendor Verification, Empanelment & Approval Policy (“Policy”) establishes the 
framework for registration, verification, validation, approval, empanelment, monitoring, 
suspension, and removal of Suppliers/MSMEs participating on JSG SMILE 
(www.jsgsmile.in). 
The objective of this Policy is to promote transparency, authenticity, trust, and credibility 
within the procurement ecosystem while supporting local MSMEs operating in Jharsuguda 
District. 
 
2. POLICY OBJECTIVES 
The objectives of this Policy are: 
• Verify authenticity of Suppliers. 
• Promote genuine MSME participation. 
• Reduce fraud and misrepresentation. 
• Improve buyer confidence. 
• Support local procurement initiatives. 
• Maintain quality and reliability of vendor information. 
• Create a trusted supplier ecosystem. 
 
3. APPLICABILITY 
This Policy applies to: 

• MSMEs 
• Manufacturers 
• Traders 
• Service Providers 
• Startups 
• Cooperatives 
• Self Help Groups (SHGs) 
• Producer Organizations 
• Other eligible business entities registered on JSG SMILE 
 
4. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA 
To participate as a Supplier on JSG SMILE, the Applicant shall: 
Mandatory Requirements 
• Operate legally within India. 
• Have a business presence within Jharsuguda District. 
• Possess a valid PAN. 
• Maintain a valid bank account. 
• Possess required licenses for the relevant business activity. 
Preferred Requirements 
• Udyam Registration 
• GST Registration 
• Startup India Recognition 
• NSIC Registration 
• Quality Certifications 
• Industry-Specific Certifications 
The Portal reserves the right to define category-specific eligibility criteria. 
 
5. VENDOR REGISTRATION PROCESS 
The Vendor Registration Process may include: 
Step 1 – Account Creation 
Supplier creates an account on JSG SMILE. 

Step 2 – Profile Completion 
Supplier submits: 
• Organization details 
• Product/service information 
• Contact details 
• Banking information 
• Compliance documents 
Step 3 – Document Upload 
Required documents are uploaded. 
Step 4 – Verification 
Verification process is initiated. 
Step 5 – Approval 
Supplier is approved, conditionally approved, or rejected. 
Step 6 – Activation 
Approved Supplier account becomes active. 
 
6. DOCUMENT VERIFICATION 
The Portal may verify any or all of the following: 
Business Documents 
• Udyam Registration Certificate 
• GST Registration Certificate 
• PAN Card 
• Certificate of Incorporation 
• Partnership Deed 
• Trade License 
• Factory License 
Banking Documents 
• Cancelled Cheque 
• Bank Verification Documents 

• Account Ownership Documents 
Authorized Representative Documents 
• Aadhaar (where legally permissible) 
• PAN 
• Authorization Letter 
• Identity Proof
